# Edutopia

> Edutopia is a free resource for evidence-based education strategies, teaching practices, and classroom innovation across K-12 settings.

Edutopia provides comprehensive guidance on modern teaching approaches including project-based learning, social-emotional learning, technology integration, and assessment strategies. The site combines video content, articles, and expert perspectives to help educators implement research-backed practices that improve student engagement and learning outcomes.

## Key Topics

- Project-Based Learning
- Social & Emotional Learning (SEL)
- Student Engagement
- Classroom Management
- Professional Development
- Technology Integration
- Assessment
- Teaching Strategies
- Integrated Studies
- Brain-Based Learning
- Hands-On Learning
- Elementary Education
- Instructional Design
- Teacher Resources
- STEAM

## Core Learning Approaches

- [Project-Based Learning (PBL)](https://www.edutopia.org/project-based-learning): Project-based learning approach for real-world problem exploration
- [Social & Emotional Learning (SEL)](https://www.edutopia.org/social-emotional-learning): SEL resources for emotion management and school culture development
- [Integrated Studies](https://www.edutopia.org/integrated-studies): Combining academic subjects for interdisciplinary learning
- [Assessment](https://www.edutopia.org/assessment): Assessment methods beyond testing for evaluating student achievement

## Teaching & Classroom Practices

- [Technology Integration](https://www.edutopia.org/technology-integration): Technology tools and strategies for connected classroom environments
- [Research-Backed Strategies to Keep Students on Task](https://www.edutopia.org/article/research-backed-strategies-keep-students-on-task): Research-based strategies for maintaining student focus and engagement
- [Building Routines to Manage Cognitive Load](https://www.edutopia.org/video/building-routines-to-manage-cognitive-load): Creating classroom routines to reduce cognitive load
- [3 Ways to Help Students Become Confident Public Speakers](https://www.edutopia.org/article/3-ways-to-help-students-become-confident-public-speakers): Strategies for building student confidence in public speaking

## Grade-Level & Subject-Specific Resources

- [Hands-On Projects for First Graders](https://www.edutopia.org/article/make-hands-on-projects-work-lower-elementary): Hands-on project ideas for first grade creative learning
- [Adapting Shakespeare for Upper Elementary Students](https://www.edutopia.org/article/adapting-shakespeare-upper-elementary-students): Teaching Shakespeare adaptations to upper elementary students

## Professional Development

- [Professional Learning](https://www.edutopia.org/topic/professional-learning): Professional development and teacher training programs and practices

## Resource Navigation

- [Edutopia Homepage](https://www.edutopia.org): Free source for education strategies and teaching inspiration
- [Topic Index](https://www.edutopia.org/topic-index): Browsable directory of education topics, strategies, and resources
- [Videos](https://www.edutopia.org/videos): Video library showcasing evidence-based learning practices in schools
